name: looprepair
description: LoopRepair: location-aware, trace-guided iterative LLM repair — upstream's LLM stage (repair-sequence prediction + function-level patch generation, 5 samples per location, up to 3 iterations from the best test-failing patches); CrashRepair's crash/KLEE analysis replaced by cvebench FL locations, the trigger's failure signature and its gcov trace on the patched program
reference: Z. Ye, X. Sun, S. Cao, L. Bo, B. Li. Well Begun is Half Done: Location-Aware and Trace-Guided Iterative Automated Vulnerability Repair. ICSE 2026 (ACM SIGSOFT Distinguished Paper).
